# Pre-market brief — Mon 2026-11-23 (~8:25 AM ET)

**1. Broad relief rally after a week of correction.** Futures ~8:01 AM ET: S&P +2.44%, Nasdaq-100 +3.18%, Dow +1.77% ([Markets Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/premarket/1000)); AP shows S&P +2.9% / Nasdaq +3.6% in later quotes ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-rates-technology-ai-anthropic-49ba1beba78fa4ed2bd5898029f79c91)). All three benchmarks had fallen into correction last week ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-chip-stocks-lead-ai-rebound-crowdstrike-falls-5045110)).

**2. Semis and AI names bounce hard, but stay on avoid.** Pre-market: NVDA +8.7%, AMD +5.8%, AVGO +5.7%, MU +7%, LRCX and MRVL >+7%, CRWV +10.1%, NBIS +11.1%, IREN +10.2% ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-chip-stocks-lead-ai-rebound-crowdstrike-falls-5045110)). We hold the group avoid (lessons 11/06 and 10/23: a sector-shock bounce plus gaps over 5% means no adds). Re-review after DELL/HPQ (11/24 AMC).

**3. CrowdStrike buys Zscaler.** The all-stock deal is about $43.9B: 1.135 CRWD per ZS share, implying $260.41, a ~34% premium. ZS >+13%, CRWD >−8% pre ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-chip-stocks-lead-ai-rebound-crowdstrike-falls-5045110)). Both go on avoid: ZS is pinned to the deal and CRWD has a >5% gap plus deal overhang.

**4. Rates are hawkish.** The 10-year is 4.959% (+4bp) and the 2-year 4.689% (+7bp). CME prices a ~96% chance of a December hike. Fed's Williams speaks today ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/treasury-yields-bonds-fed.html)). Brent $91.97 (−0.65%), WTI $82.92 ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/oil-prices-fall-amid-equity-sell-off-though-iran-war-attacks-limit-losses.html)). BTC is back above $61k ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/11/23/live-updates-bitcoin-climbs-back-above-usd61-000-as-stocks-rebound-from-ai-rout)); the crypto avoid stays.

**Week ahead (Thanksgiving week).** Mon: flash PMIs 9:45, Williams 16:00. HPE, A, ZM report AMC. Tue: ADI, BBY, MDT, DLTR report BMO; consumer confidence 10:00; DELL, HPQ, ADSK, WDAY report AMC. Wed: PCE/core PCE, Q3 GDP (2nd), durables, and claims at 8:30, DE BMO, Beige Book 14:00. Thu: closed. Fri: stocks close at 13:00. Calendar from the 11/22 review (reviews/avoid_review_2026-11-22.md).

**Housekeeping:** COST goes ex-dividend 11/24, so exit by today's close per the open-call note.

## Swing ideas
- **No new longs today.** This is the session after a sector-shock bounce, gaps are >5%, and the tape is in correction with a December hike ~96% priced (lessons 11/06, 10/23). Existing holds stand; TGT and TJX (non-tech beat-and-raise) remain the preferred holds. Confidence: low. Key risk: a hawkish Williams or a hot PCE on Wed.
